description: Get the concepts (people, organisations, places) that are trending right now in the news — computed by comparing mentions in the last 2 days against the last 2 weeks. Use `source` to switch between news, social, pr and blog (blog trends are not computed on every plan: the API then answers "not computed" and the call is still billed). Defaults to the top 10 people/organisations/places in news. Cost: 10 tokens per call regardless of count (measured live) - the priciest tool, use sparingly.

concept_types.description: Concept kinds to include (default: person, org, loc). Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

source.description: Data source to compute trends from (default news).

name: get_trending_concepts
